notes: Both images were generated with the built-in image_gen tool; no paid image API was called.
The hero is a photographic comparison scene and the inline image is a tactile four-stage process diagram.
Both outputs were visually inspected for relevance, repetition, text, logos, and internal similarity before use.

prompt_policy.api_cost_policy: Do not call OpenAI Images API or external paid image APIs.
prompt_policy.prompt_method: A fresh one-off prompt was written for each article-specific image role immediately before generation.
prompt_policy.diversity_rule: Avoid repeated traveler-with-phone, luggage-only airport, skyline-only, and cafe-table phone scenes. Keep hero and inline compositions distinct.
prompt_policy.quality_loop: Discard and regenerate any generic, repeated, text-heavy, off-topic, or internally similar result.

images.alt: Two unlabeled food delivery order trays compared side by side in a Korean apartment lobby
images.caption: A side-by-side choice between two Korean food-delivery checkout paths.
images.prompt: Fresh one-off hero prompt, not a reusable template. Image role and purpose: wide photorealistic comparison hero for Baemin vs Coupang Eats for foreigners. Create a modern Seoul apartment lobby delivery shelf divided into two order setups: a mint-accented insulated bag with tteokbokki and dumplings on the left, and a warm-orange-accented bag with fried chicken and a rice bowl on the right. Add blank receipt slips, two route tokens, and a neutral card wallet. Eye-level three-quarter view, soft morning window light, believable Korean food packaging. Recent-image avoidance: avoid repeated traveler holding a phone, airport luggage, skyline, cafe table, tourist pose, fake app screen, logos, readable text, and watermarks.

images.alt: A text-free delivery checkout flow showing address, payment, restaurant acceptance, and backup pickup stages
images.caption: Four gates determine whether a delivery order will actually work.
images.prompt: Fresh one-off inline prompt, not a reusable template. Image role and purpose: text-free four-stage process diagram for a foreign visitor's Korean delivery checkout. Use tactile miniature objects connected by one route line: apartment model with map pin and key tag for address; payment card with shield; restaurant kitchen pass with covered meal and confirmation light; storefront pickup counter with takeaway bag as backup. Add one amber warning marker between payment and acceptance. Top-down 3:2 realistic 3D editorial diagram on terrazzo and brushed metal. Recent-image avoidance: make this visually different from the lobby hero; avoid repeated photography, people, phones, app UI, readable text, logos, skyline, luggage, cafe scenes, and watermarks.
